Package org.osgi.test.cases.upnp.tbc.device.discovery

Class ServicesListener

java.lang.Object
org.osgi.util.tracker.ServiceTracker<UPnPDevice,UPnPDevice>
org.osgi.test.cases.upnp.tbc.device.discovery.ServicesListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.osgi.util.tracker.ServiceTrackerCustomizer<UPnPDevice,UPnPDevice>
public class ServicesListener extends org.osgi.util.tracker.ServiceTracker<UPnPDevice,UPnPDevice>
Seems to track the latest registration/modification/unregistration of a device. It was using a service listener with all dangers associated. It also did not discriminate between the looked for devices and the existing or found devices on the network.
